The Ryan White  Part A program at the Ohio State University Infectious Diseases clinic uses 340B savings to provide a variety of services to the community including: 
-Transportation to improve access and adherence to appointments.
- Basic cell phones for patients with identified health disparities to allow for communication with clinic staff, physicians, and pharmacists. This service has improved access, reduced no shows, and enhanced medication adherence.
- Physician & pharmacist staffing effort to allow more time with patients with complex needs. 
- Patient navigation to assist patients maintain adherence to their treatment goals.
- Benefit navigation to help patients access services they may be eligible to obtain (e.g., Medicaid, Medicare). 
- Access to non-perishables for patients with acute nutrition needs.
- Prescription coverage  for patients unable to pay for medications.
